methodology.source: archive weekly snapshots in this repository
methodology.comparison_basis: unit_price_dkk when available; otherwise package price

scoring.very_good: current price > 80% and <= 90% of recent median
scoring.good: current price > 90% and <= 97% of recent median
scoring.normal: current price > 97% and <= 105% of recent median

note: Starter file. Historical scores become meaningful as weekly archive snapshots accumulate. Claude must not claim a reliable historical deal score until minimum observations are met.
